scripts.build:test: cross-env SETTINGS_OVERRIDE=tests/fixtures/settings.json ASTRO_OUT_DIR=dist-test astro build && node scripts/check-dist.mjs dist-test --strict
scripts.build:i18n: cross-env SETTINGS_OVERRIDE=tests/fixtures/settings.json CONTENT_FIXTURES_DIR=tests/fixtures/content ENABLE_LOCALES=pt-BR,en ASTRO_OUT_DIR=dist-i18n astro build && node scripts/check-dist.mjs dist-i18n --strict
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:test && npm run build:i18n && playwright test
scripts.qa: npm run check && npm run lint:text && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run test:e2e && npm run lighthouse
